findings.description: A second lower/front post and rail duplicate the existing upper/pool-side fence. Lower continuation and nearby foliage remain affected below the originally proposed crop bottom y2724.
findings.sourceReason: p03_01 redraws a lower rail beneath the native top anchor; p03_02 inherits that lower rail in its left anchor while its generated area follows the upper rail.
findings.remediation: Keep the upper/pool-side rail; remove duplicate front post/rail and restore gray paving/attached foliage, then inspect all native-size patch boundaries.

findings.description: Vertical deck-board end joint at x~230 stops at y=0. Must continue only into the new child side until its true diagonal plank boundary, preserving north core.
Child-side diagonal grout begins at x=0 around y1090 but west stone has no matching groove.
Stone joint begins/turns at x=0 around y2278; opposing core continues a different slab layout.
West-side grout ends at x=0 around y3515; child stone face does not continue it.
Several portions change fine stone texture/tone at the core boundary. Correct alongside actual native geometry; no RGB color correction authorized.
